# use-electronics

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse electronics set.

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-electronics/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-electronics/

- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-electronics
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-electronics/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-electronics/llms-full.txt. The /sets/use-electronics/ aliases serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
